scenario.title: Orientation campus walk
scenario.intro: You are a new international student at an orientation event. A student leader is showing your group around campus. Listen and repeat what the leader says.

sentences: Please keep your name tags on.
The dining hall opens at seven every morning.
Your bus pass is waiting for you at the student center.
If you ever get lost, just follow the blue signs back to this square.
The international office, next to the bookstore, can answer questions about housing, part-time jobs, and forms.
Before the welcome dinner tonight, make sure you have activated your student email account, because all of your class schedules will be sent there.
